# 2.4.5 Multiple Ways (Level AA)

- Principle: 2 Operable
- Guideline: 2.4 Navigable
- Level: AA
- Versions: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/multiple-ways.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#multiple-ways

## Normative text

More than one way is available to locate a [web page](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-web-page-s) within a [set of web pages](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-set-of-web-pages) except where the web page is the result of, or a step in, a [process](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-processes).

## Sufficient techniques

- Using two or more of the following techniques: using one of:
  - G125: Providing links to navigate to related web pages
  - G64: Providing a Table of Contents
  - G63: Providing a site map
  - G161: Providing a search function to help users find content
  - G126: Providing a list of links to all other web pages
  - G185: Linking to all of the pages on the site from the home page
